_comment: Heterogeneous fleet tier config. Each box runs run-benchmark.sh with a REDUCED systems.json (its systems) + REDUCED config.json (its noises). shard_by lists the dims split across boxes; un-split dims run all-on-one-box. cells/box = |systems|*|arms|*|noises|*NUM_TESTS. Box vCPU: ccx33=8, ccx43=16. Edit box counts via shard_by granularity.
